March 15, 2018 - By Marie Mckinney 
Blume Capital Management Inc increased its stake in Walt Disney (DIS) by 21.79% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Blume Capital Management Inc bought 8,590 shares as the company’s stock declined 2.31% while stock markets rallied. The institutional investor held 48,014 shares of the television services company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $4.73 million, up from 39,424 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Blume Capital Management Inc who had been investing in Walt Disney for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $156.32B market cap company. The stock increased 0.06% or $0.06   $103.96. About 2.16M shares traded. The Walt Disney Company (NYSE:DIS) has risen 9.26%   uptrending. It has underperformed by 7.44% the S&P500. 
Clean Yield Group decreased its stake in Liberty Ppty Tr Sh Ben Int (LPT) by 40.6% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Clean Yield Group sold 33,605 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.20% with the market. The institutional investor held 49,172 shares of the real estate investment trusts company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $2.02M, down from 82,777 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Clean Yield Group who had been investing in Liberty Ppty Tr Sh Ben Int for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $6.04 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.10% or $0.04   $40.02. About 504,240 shares traded. Liberty Property Trust (NYSE:LPT) has risen 14.91%   uptrending. It has underperformed by 1.79% the S&P500.
